question: 'Ladaladi’ is a folk dance of the ________, in which the bride and bridegroom are lifted upon the shouldrs and others dance around the couple.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhils**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ladaladi** is a **folk dance** of the **Bhil community**, performed during weddings.
 
• It is a unique tradition where the **bride and bridegroom** are lifted upon the shoulders of the dancers.
 
• The dance symbolizes **celebration and happiness** and brings the community together to mark the joyous occasion.
